purpose: T0.7 (rescoped): do -ip / -O3 / -heap-arrays help on Aitken, where we are already vectorised?

config.note: All arms at SubgridSizeAutoAdjustMinimum=512, same source (c73ee4b6), concurrent on separate nodes.

verdict: NULL RESULT. Both variants are marginally SLOWER than control (+1.2%, +1.7%), inside the ~1.6% node scatter. Neither -ip nor -O3 buys anything.
why: The audit's headline for T0.7 (1.5-3x on Fortran kernels) was about restoring vectorisation to Make.mach.pleiades-mpich, which had been cut to -g -O2. Pleiades is decommissioned, and Aitken already carries -march=core-avx2. The remaining surface for -ip is Enzo's own Fortran, mainly hydro at ~5% of wall, so there was never much to win.
recommendation: Close T0.7. Do not restore Pleiades flags (machine gone). Keep -march=core-avx2 over -xCORE-AVX2 on Milan: the -x form triggers Intel vendor dispatch, which can select a slow path on non-Intel CPUs.
